supporting_observations.claim: WS-NKIM-01 made repeated TCP connections to the internal proxy at 10.53.20.30:8080 during the alerted period. The available records identify the service as HTTP to the proxy, not the ultimate destination.

Several proxy connections have similar byte counts, including roughly 6.7–7.0 KB sent and 19.7 KB received. This repeated pattern is compatible with periodic update checking, but the records do not identify the application or establish that it is benign.
The connection times are recurring but not uniformly spaced at roughly five-minute intervals; for example, records show connections at 13:39:48 and 13:40:41, then at 13:44:40 and 13:50:02 UTC.

known_telemetry_limitations: The provided network records show connections from WS-NKIM-01 to the internal proxy on port 8080, but do not include proxy request logs identifying the external host, URL, or HTTPS CONNECT destination.
The provided records do not attribute the proxy connections to a process on WS-NKIM-01, so they cannot confirm whether CaseBinder's updater generated them.
claims_not_established: Whether the proxy connections reached update.casebinder.com or another destination.
Whether the activity was generated by the approved CaseBinder updater or by another process.
Whether the repeated traffic transferred only routine update-check data or included other content.
additional_evidence_needed: PROXY-MAP-01 request logs for the listed timestamps, including CONNECT target or URL, authenticated user or client, response status, and transferred byte counts.
Endpoint process-to-network telemetry for WS-NKIM-01 covering the proxy connections, including process image, command line, parent process, and file signature or hash.
CaseBinder updater execution and update-check logs for the same period to compare against the observed connection times and traffic.
unrelated_findings: DC-MAP-01 initiated connections to WS-NKIM-01 on ports 445 and 443 that were rejected, followed by a recorded RDP connection from DC-MAP-01 to WS-NKIM-01. The inventory says remote administration is only done from WS-AHASSAN-01; review this separately without using it to decide the alerted proxy activity. (T156-00185, T156-00187, T156-00190)
